SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS total_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.customers c
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = 'ryan byrd'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
